en.title: S.C.M. - A.E.C. - M.C.
en.decryption: Divides the 8-fold path: 2 Wisdom (View/Resolve), 3 Conduct (Speech/Action/Livelihood), 3 Concentration (Effort/Mindfulness/Concentration).

hi.title: S.C.M. - A.E.C. - M.C.
hi.decryption: Divides the 8-fold path: 2 Wisdom (View/Resolve), 3 Conduct (Speech/Action/Livelihood), 3 Concentration (Effort/Mindfulness/Concentration).

fact.en: Do not confuse the Eightfold Path (practice) with the Four Noble Truths (theory).
fact.hi: Do not confuse the Eightfold Path (practice) with the Four Noble Truths (theory).

fact.en: The Path is often called 'Madhyama Pratipada' (Middle Way), avoiding extremes of self-indulgence and self-mortification.
